events.summary: iOS 18 Beta 1 is represented by 14 source-supported changes selected from Apple’s preserved 196-record initial state; no build number or unsupported milestone payload is inferred.

blocks.text: Preserved release-note state
The reader-facing Apple archive identifies this document as “iOS & iPadOS 18 Beta Release Notes.” This iOS overlay selects 14 substantive records from the 196-record initial state.
How this milestone differs

This is a representative baseline rather than an exhaustive conversion of all 196 records. The published selection emphasizes exact issue-ID additions and status transitions rather than every wording edit.
Platform scope
Items explicitly limited to iPad or iPadOS are excluded from this route. iPhone-only notes and shared iOS/iPadOS framework behavior are retained where the source text supports that scope.
Editorial boundary

The page contains original synthesis and issue-ID locators. It does not reproduce Apple’s list text, infer a build number, or copy cumulative notes into unsupported milestones. Apple’s beta guidance treats these seeds as prerelease software.

citations.locator: Beta software, release notes, and Feedback Assistant

changes.title: AdAttributionKit re-engagement attribution
changes.canonicalSummary: AdAttributionKit added click-through re-engagement measurement and Universal Link deep linking for already-installed apps.
changes.summary: The first preserved state documents re-engagement measurement and deep links for previously installed apps.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: MapKit place identity and place cards
changes.canonicalSummary: MapKit added persistent Place IDs, more local-search result categories, and an API for presenting place-card interfaces.
changes.summary: The initial notes group three related MapKit additions: Place IDs, expanded search result types, and place-card presentation.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: System memory allocator implementation
changes.canonicalSummary: The system allocator changed for most allocation sizes, potentially exposing latent memory bugs and altering allocation-heavy performance or fragmentation.
changes.summary: Apple warned developers that a new allocator implementation could reveal existing memory defects and change allocation behavior.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: RealityKit subdivision and Display P3 rendering
changes.canonicalSummary: RealityKit added Catmull-Clark subdivision rendering for qualifying USD meshes and Display P3 rendering for virtual objects.
changes.summary: The initial state adds subdivision rendering with documented resource costs and expands virtual-object rendering to Display P3.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: StoreKit renewal and offer metadata
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit subscription status gained renewal price, currency, and next-renewal offer information.
changes.summary: Subscription status objects can expose renewal pricing, currency, and the offer expected for the next renewal.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Swift Charts function and vectorized plots
changes.canonicalSummary: Swift Charts added function plots and vectorized plotting APIs intended to render large datasets more efficiently.
changes.summary: The first state introduces LinePlot and AreaPlot for math functions plus vectorized PointPlot and RectanglePlot APIs.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI automatic sheet sizing
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI sheets linked against the new SDK adopted automatic presentation sizing with platform-dependent form or fitted behavior.
changes.summary: Apps linking against the new SDK need to audit sheets because their default presentation sizing changed.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI default MainActor isolation
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI protocol conformances became MainActor-isolated by default to improve compile-time data-race diagnostics.
changes.summary: The SDK applies default MainActor isolation to View and related protocol conformances while leaving runtime evaluation behavior unchanged.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: SwiftUI Entry macro
changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI added the Entry macro to simplify custom environment, focused, transaction, and container value declarations.
changes.summary: The Entry macro reduces boilerplate for several custom SwiftUI value containers.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Translation APIs and Hindi support
changes.canonicalSummary: The system added app-facing translation sessions and Hindi across the Translate app, system translation, Safari, and the new APIs.
changes.summary: Apps gained a translation-session API while the broader translation stack added Hindi support.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Original StoreKit API deprecation
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple deprecated the original in-app purchase API family in favor of current StoreKit APIs.
changes.summary: The initial notes mark the legacy in-app purchase classes and requests as deprecated.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Messages via satellite
changes.canonicalSummary: Messages added satellite messaging in the United States, with SMS-over-satellite availability limited to participating carriers.
changes.summary: The first preserved iOS state records the initial United States and carrier scope for messaging over satellite.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Siri response audio over a vehicle media source
changes.canonicalSummary: Siri added an option to route responses through a vehicle’s Bluetooth media source when CarPlay is unavailable.
changes.summary: The iPhone-only note describes improved Siri audio through a vehicle media source without CarPlay.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Legacy Today View extensions removed
changes.canonicalSummary: iOS 18 removed support for legacy Today View extensions.
changes.summary: Apple’s deprecation section states that legacy Today View extensions are removed in iOS 18.
changes.verificationMethod: Selected as a representative initial capability, API change, deprecation, or platform behavior from Apple’s first preserved Beta 1 DocC state; the baseline is intentionally not exhaustive.

changes.title: Higher on-demand resource limits
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple increased on-demand resource limits for iOS 18 and iPadOS 18 alongside other platforms.

changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID in the 219-record Beta 2 state against the 196-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Bluetooth headphone audio routing
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed Bluetooth headphones being unavailable as an audio route under some AVAudioSession configurations.
changes.summary: Beta 2 adds a resolved audio-routing issue affecting some Bluetooth headphone and AVAudioSession combinations.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID in the 219-record Beta 2 state against the 196-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Duplicate app-container handling
changes.canonicalSummary: The system improved handling of duplicate containers created by older Xcode versions so apps launch consistently and deletion removes duplicates.
changes.summary: Beta 2 documents more consistent launch and deletion behavior when Xcode 15 through 15.3 created duplicate device containers.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID in the 219-record Beta 2 state against the 196-record Beta 1 state.

changes.title: Camera startup delay
changes.canonicalSummary: Apple fixed camera functions taking as long as two minutes to become available after an iPhone or iPad booted.
changes.summary: The Beta 1 known issue becomes resolved in Beta 2 for both iPhone and iPad.
changes.verificationMethod: Matched the component, status heading, and retained issue ID in the 219-record Beta 2 state against the 196-record Beta 1 state.
